messages:
elena_sales: Heads-up — NorthBridge legal just asked for a rush compliance package for the Dedicated POC we demoed. They want SOC2 artifacts, a signed pen-test letter (scope + dates), network diagram for our staging, and confirmation of on-prem install feasibility. Deadline: EOD Friday. Can we assemble and sign?
sam_security: Ok — scope question first: do they require vendor pen-test (third-party) or is a pen-test attestation from our SOC vendor OK? Also need to know if they want results or just an attestation letter.
matt_eng: For the staging network diagram I can produce a sanitized diagram showing segmentation and NAT/egress guards, but need to know which IPs to redact. We shouldn't publish internal IP ranges.
elena_sales: They said "full letter with scope and test dates" — legal prefers signed pen-test letter from our vendor but will accept our attestation if vendor letter is delayed. IPs should be redacted but they want clear subnet boundaries and TLS termination points.
kira_cust_success: Pricing question came up too — they asked if Dedicated POC pricing changes when we provide on-prem artifacts / pen-test support. Sales expects a quick note for procurement: is there an extra compliance fee or is this covered under existing POC entitlements?
audit_bot: Automated checklist created: [SOC2_artifacts, pen_test_letter_template_v2.pdf, network_diagram_sanitization_guidance, staging_creds_process.md]
sam_security: I can populate pen_test_letter_template_v2.pdf and get legal to sign the attestation by Thu midday. For a vendor-signed cert we need the external pentester's engagement letter — that usually takes 5–7 business days.
matt_eng: I'll drop a sanitized diagram to the shared drive. Example snippet for the diagram legend to ensure redaction:
```
- Service VLAN: <REDACTED>
- Staging Instance: staging-*.redwood-inference.net
- Egress: NAT via egress-prod-rtr (no public inbound)
```
elena_sales: Perfect. Also they asked for short notes on our key rotation and KMS integration (FIPS / HSM). Sam, can you provide a 1-paragraph summary we can hand to procurement?
sam_security: Yep. Drafting: "Redwood uses customer-specific KMS keys with automated rotation policies. Key material can be managed via customer KMS or Redwood-managed keys with HSM-backed storage. Rotation cadence defaults to 90 days; emergency rotation is supported via API and audited in CloudAudit logs." I will post final text shortly.
kira_cust_success: On the pricing bit — there's no extra compliance fee for providing standard SOC2 artifacts and a pen-test attestation. If they request a bespoke on-prem packaging or dedicated on-site audit support, we would quote separately. I'll add that to the procurement note.
elena_sales: Can we get a fast bundle: sanitized network diagram, pen-test attestation (signed), SOC2 summary page (scope + control owner list), and the KMS paragraph? If everything is ready by Thu EOD we can confirm the EOD Friday deadline to NorthBridge.
matt_eng: Uploading diagram into GDrive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example (redacted link for thread). I'll mark files with "REDACTED" where needed.
sam_security: Pen-test attestation uploaded to the same folder. I redacted IPs and removed internal hostnames. File: pen_test_attestation_NorthBridge_signed.pdf
elena_sales: Amazing — one last ask from legal: they want an explicit line confirming we will not reuse their POC data for model training. Can security/legal provide a single-sentence commitment we can paste?
sam_security: Quick line: "Redwood Inference will not use customer-provided POC data for model training or improvement; data is processed solely for evaluation and is deleted per the agreed retention policy unless otherwise authorized in writing." Feel free to pass to legal for final approval.
elena_sales: Thank you all — I'll bundle and send to NorthBridge once legal confirms the sentence. :thumbsup:
